privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page is maintained by the SAHA Santé team to answer common questions about the privacy and security of the SAHA Santé app (the “App”). It describes the data we collect, how we use it and the choices you have.
privacy.s1AccountText: email, full name, preferred language and role (patient, pharmacy, courier, admin).
privacy.s1RxText: photos or PDFs of prescriptions you upload, and the medicines automatically extracted by our AI system.
privacy.s1LocationText: approximate or precise position, used only to find nearby pharmacies and for delivery.
privacy.s1CameraText: access requested only when you choose to photograph a prescription. No background capture.
privacy.s1NotifText: device token for notifications about your reservations and deliveries.
privacy.s2Text: Your data is used to run the App: analyze your prescriptions, find partner pharmacies that have the prescribed medicines, manage reservations and coordinate delivery. Health data is never used for advertising.
privacy.s3PharmacyText: receives your prescription and your contact details strictly needed to prepare the order.
privacy.s3CourierText: receives the delivery address and pickup point, only for the duration of the trip.
privacy.s3SubText: Hostinger (server and database hosting), Google Maps (geolocation and routes), AI provider (medicine extraction). These providers process your data on our behalf and under contract.
privacy.s3NoSale: We do not sell your personal data.
privacy.s4Text: Prescriptions and reservations are kept as long as needed to follow up on the service and to meet legal obligations. You can request account deletion at any time.
privacy.s5Text: Data is encrypted in transit (HTTPS) and at rest. Access to prescriptions is restricted through row-level security (RLS) rules: only the patient, the receiving pharmacy and the assigned courier can access it.
privacy.s6Text: You can access, correct or delete your data, revoke camera/location permissions from your phone settings, and request an export of your data by contacting us.
privacy.s7Text: The App is not intended for children under 13. Minors must use the App under the responsibility of a parent or guardian.
privacy.contactIntro: For any question or request about your data, contact:
privacy.s9Text: We may update this policy. In case of a significant change, we will notify you in the App.
